content:
This week we're bringing you the latest updates from the Apple Certified Refurbished store. This week's highlights include the MacBook Neo, new MacBook Air configurations, Apple Watch Ultra 3, and more.

The Apple Certified Refurbished store is a great way to purchase products through Apple's official website, with savings of up to 15%.

Here's what you need to know:

  • Quality products at attractive prices
  • Undergo a strict refurbishment process before being sold
  • Backed by Apple's one-year limited warranty
  • Covered by Apple's 14-day return policy
  • AppleCare products available for additional purchase
  • Engraving and gift wrapping services are not available for refurbished products

We track every addition and removal in the Apple Certified Refurbished store to save you the hassle of searching on your own. Inventory changes quickly, and the goal of this post is to give you information about what's currently available so you can get your hands on the product you want before it sells out.

Mac

The pricing on the MacBook Neo and MacBook Air remains my favorite deal. Both are great for users just joining the Apple ecosystem, or for upgrading to a product with Apple Silicon chips.

MacBook Neo

  • MacBook Neo (256GB storage): $599 (originally $699)
  • MacBook Neo (512GB storage with Touch ID): $679 (originally $799)

MacBook Air

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air (512GB storage, 16GB memory): $1,099 (originally $1,299)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air (1TB storage, 16GB memory): $1,529 (originally $1,799)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air (2TB storage, 16GB memory): $1,949 (originally $2,299)

iMac

  • 24-inch M4 iMac (256GB storage, 16GB memory): $1,269 (originally $1,499)
  • 24-inch M4 iMac (512GB storage, 16GB memory): $1,439 (originally $1,699)

Studio Display

As we mentioned earlier, the Studio Display XDR has appeared in the Apple Refurbished store. As we often remind everyone, inventory can change quickly, and the Studio Display XDR is no exception. As of today, only two configurations remain in stock:

  • Studio Display XDR (standard glass with tilt- and height-adjustable stand): $2,799 (originally $3,299)
  • Studio Display XDR (nano-texture glass with tilt- and height-adjustable stand): $3,059 (originally $3,599)

Apple TV 4K

The long-awaited entry-level Apple TV 4K is back in stock this week, alongside the higher-end version with an Ethernet port. The entry-level model typically sells out quickly, so if you're interested, don't miss your chance.

  • Apple TV 4K (3rd generation, 64GB storage, Wi-Fi): $169 (originally $199)
  • Apple TV 4K (3rd generation, 128GB storage, Wi-Fi + Ethernet): $209 (originally $249)

Apple Watch Ultra

I wear the Apple Watch Ultra 3 every day. If you want the same experience, here are this week's highlights from the Apple Refurbished store:

  • Apple Watch Ultra 3 (GPS + Cellular), 49mm black titanium case with black ocean band: $679 (originally $799)
  • Apple Watch Ultra 3 (GPS + Cellular), 49mm natural titanium case with blue ocean band: $679 (originally $799)

As always, you can head over to 9to5Tools to keep up with all the latest Apple deals this week.
